fields.description:
**Related:** WAGR-5, WAGR-49
**Timebox:** 4 hours. Exceeding it triggers a conversation, not silent expansion.

**Summary:** The Sep 1 and Sep 10 checks found 178 clicks that did not arrive, and a Hard Rock rep ID error. Nobody recorded a cause. The high-volume rep test status is also unclear.

**Investigate:** why the clicks were lost, and whether it still happens; the rep ID error; whether the SLC payload should carry the link or study title so errors are easier to trace (Kobi, Aug 21); whether the CMS sends UTC timestamps.

**Done when:** the findings and a recommendation are on this ticket, and any follow-up Bug or Story is linked.

**Sources (traceable):**

* Weekly sync, 2026-09-01 (lost clicks) — https://fathom.video/calls/804141114
* Kobi, Slack 2026-08-21 (link/study title in SLC payload) — https://jumpr-solutions.slack.com/archives/C0BBC05C2HG/p1787341514523909
* Weekly sync, 2026-08-25 (UTC timestamps) — https://fathom.video/calls/795654305
